# Introduction

This document shows the small changes made to the ICCAT dataset, already in the CWP format
and with the CWP codes, before it enters the Global Tuna Atlas (the changes are summarised below).
It is generated from the function `gta_rawdata_cwp_format()` (`R/rawdata_cwp_format.R`), the code that the Global Tuna Atlas workflow runs.

The raw dataset is read from the `data/` folder next to this document, which holds the first
lines of each file under the name given by the tRFMO at export (this name may change).
The result is saved in the same folder.

*Knit the document from the repository (here::here() locates its root), or run it chunk by chunk.*

# The function


This function preprocesses catch data for harmonization, including renaming columns, converting data types,
and filtering records. It then exports the processed data along with associated code lists as CSV files.

@details
The function performs several steps to prepare the catch data for further processing or integration:
- Reads the dataset from a specified path.
- Optionally renames the 'fishingfleet' column to 'fishing_fleet' if it exists.
- Converts time fields to character format, then to Date, and numerically transforms the 'measurement_value'.
- Filters out records with a 'measurement_value' of zero.
- Selects specific columns for the final dataset.
- Calculates and sets the temporal extent of the dataset based on the time fields.

It relies on the 'dplyr' package for data manipulation and 'readr' for reading CSV files. The function assumes

@examples
\dontrun{
}

@param data The dataset, already in CWP format (ICCAT, IOTC): a data frame, or
  the path to the CSV file.
@return The harmonized dataset (data frame), as written by the geoflow action
  (cwp_format/action_cwp_format.R).

```{r}
# Packages the function uses unqualified, attached as in the workflow
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(data.table); library(reshape2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readxl) })
pkgload::load_all(here::here(), export_all = TRUE, helpers = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)   # gta package of the repository
gta_rawdata_cwp_format <- function(data) {
  catches <- gta_data(data, reader = function(path) readr::read_csv(path, guess_max = 0))
  #----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  
  ## Catches
  if("fishingfleet" %in%colnames(catches)){
  catches <- catches %>% dplyr::rename(fishing_fleet = fishingfleet) 
  }
  
  # IOTC gives the processing level in measurement_obs ("raised", "unknown",
  # "original sample"): same codes as measurement_processing_level, with a space
  if(!"measurement_processing_level" %in% colnames(catches) && "measurement_obs" %in% colnames(catches)){
    catches$measurement_processing_level <- gsub(" ", "_", catches$measurement_obs, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  if(!"measurement_processing_level" %in% colnames(catches)){
    catches$measurement_processing_level <- "raised"
  }
  
  catches <- catches %>% dplyr::mutate( time_start = as.character(time_start), time_end = as.character(time_end),  geographic_identifier= as.character(geographic_identifier), measurement_value = as.numeric(catches$measurement_value))
  
  catches <- catches %>% filter(measurement_value!= 0)
  
  catches<-catches %>% dplyr::select("fishing_fleet","gear_type","time_start","time_end","geographic_identifier",
                                     "fishing_mode","species","measurement_type","measurement_unit","measurement_value", "source_authority", "measurement_processing_level") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(geographic_identifier = as.character(geographic_identifier))
  
  #----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #@eblondel additional formatting for next time support
  catches$time_start <- as.Date(catches$time_start)
  catches$time_end <- as.Date(catches$time_end)
  catches
}
```

# Harmonisation

```{r}
path_to_raw_dataset <- here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iccat', 'nominal', 'cwp_format', 'data', 'iccat_nominal_catch_firms_level0_20260408.csv')
georef_dataset <- gta_rawdata_cwp_format(path_to_raw_dataset)
write.csv(georef_dataset, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iccat', 'nominal', 'cwp_format', 'data', 'iccat_nominal_catch_firms_level0_20260408_harmonized.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
```

# What the function changes

Rows, columns and total of `measurement_value`, by unit, before and after the function:

```{r}
raw <- readr::read_csv(path_to_raw_dataset, guess_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE)
raw_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw$measurement_value))
data.frame(
  ` ` = c("rows", "rows with a measurement_value of 0 (removed)", "columns"),
  raw = c(nrow(raw), sum(raw_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE), ncol(raw)),
  harmonized = c(nrow(georef_dataset), sum(georef_dataset$measurement_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE), ncol(georef_dataset)),
  check.names = FALSE)
cat("Columns removed:", paste(setdiff(colnames(raw), colnames(georef_dataset)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Columns added:", paste(setdiff(colnames(georef_dataset), colnames(raw)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
merge(
  stats::aggregate(list(raw = raw_value), list(measurement_unit = raw$measurement_unit), sum, na.rm = TRUE),
  stats::aggregate(list(harmonized = georef_dataset$measurement_value), list(measurement_unit = georef_dataset$measurement_unit), sum, na.rm = TRUE),
  all = TRUE)
if ("measurement_processing_level" %in% colnames(georef_dataset)) table(measurement_processing_level = georef_dataset$measurement_processing_level, useNA = "ifany")
```
